WOODWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
